turnout.title: Delaware official statewide turnout
turnout.detail: The official Delaware Department of Elections report page summary shows 518,330 voters out of 788,441 registered voters. The importer loads that single statewide row with statewide-only coverage and warning labels because county-level turnout denominator rows are not exposed in the loaded report.
